subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this prepared model-runtime generation as the single lifecycle owner after confirming the doctor and standalone activation paths are complete on the current head?
rationale: The PR replaces a cross-cutting auth/provider/catalog ownership model, changes a released plugin SDK boundary, and carries a protected maintainer label; automated triage cannot safely choose the permanent lifecycle contract.

options.title: Approve the lifecycle owner model
options.body: Confirm the prepared generation is the canonical owner after reviewing doctor, setup, gateway reload, and embedded-runtime activation on the current head.

options.title: Request a narrower boundary
options.body: Keep lifecycle-owned snapshots for gateway runs but retain a separately documented standalone/doctor activation contract until those callers are proven.

options.title: Pause for a focused follow-up
options.body: Split unresolved activation or plugin-SDK compatibility work into a narrower reviewed change before merging the broad refactor.

recommendation.title: Approve the lifecycle owner model
recommendation.body: Confirm the prepared generation is the canonical owner after reviewing doctor, setup, gateway reload, and embedded-runtime activation on the current head.
